post_fix_estimated_coverage.basis: ~60-80% derived (primary + note + consolidated cells carry 'unconsolidated'/'consolidated' in the page title; six-year-summary/analysis pages may lack an explicit basis word -> residual fallback). NOTE: Millat primary statements explicitly say 'Unconsolidated' -> Millat basis coverage likely HIGHER than Lucky's summary pages.

reasons: B1 unchanged: no Millat extraction tables exist; enrichment does not produce Millat input.

Enrichment is NECESSARY and high-leverage but residual basis-UNKNOWN cells (titles lacking a basis word) still fall back to Lucky page ranges, which do not apply to Millat -> those cells UNKNOWN. Must validate the residual is small / non-load-bearing.

Therefore G1.3 feasibility requires: (1) implement E1-E3 enrichment, (2) re-validate Lucky that derived coverage is high and the page-range fallback is no longer load-bearing, (3) produce Millat extraction tables.
